item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:20 HKT 11/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The anticyclone aloft now covering southern China will begin to weaken today. There will be one or two showers over the coast of Guangdong. A broad trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong early next week. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather over southern China will improve in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nakri will move across the seas south of Japan today and tomorrow.
